summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.12/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.12 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 2, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 18¢ lower than a week ago, 38¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.37 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Janesville ($3.89) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.30).
